policy.comparison: Original instruction timing vs native CPU spans. Same current engine/title sources, existing native waits, enabled geometry/PGXP/settings and private byte-identical machine seed per game. Headless diagnostic/IPO/profile results are separate packages.
policy.frontend: Never-shown full presenter, normal pacing, SDL dummy audio output, PSX_DYNRES=0, fixed actual scale. No profiling instrumentation or debug tools in timed binaries.
policy.order: Two ABBA blocks per game initially,900guest frames after120frame warmup each; at most one additional block when comparability remains unresolved. Retain every raw run. Do not tune source between these runs.

observed_host_comparability.within_block_scale_pgxp_and_gameplay_pha: Must remain fixed and equivalent; exclude the block if actual requested/applied rendering changes or game leaves the intended checkpoint
observed_host_comparability.background_compilation: Always recorded and disclosed. Presence alone does not prove saturation. Only actual non-saturating comparable blocks can support loaded-host CPU evidence; do not label them idle/quiet-host results. Earlier compiler-contaminated probe pairs are not retrospectively promoted.

policy.signal: Report every block, per-package samples/range/variation and CPUms per useful guest frame, progress, draws and guest-clock cadence. A positive claim needs consistent positive block reductions beyond within-block variation; small/mixed/noisy changes are neutral/inconclusive. A reproducible per-game regression disqualifies adoption for that game; another game's gain cannot offset it.
policy.cycle_counter: Raw QueryProcessCycleTime per guest frame is an additional same-host counter. Do not convert it to elapsed time or assume it is an architecture-independent instruction count.
policy.limits: This evaluates CPU work in the collected normal-presenter checkpoint, not uncapped FPS, GPU speed, physical-speaker quality, all-title/scene compatibility or cross-host netplay. Current-build lifecycle/actual input/rollback caveats remain separately recorded. No merge or default promotion from timing alone.
policy.timestamp_correction: Actual Windows file creation timestamp; criteria unchanged. Written before first collected run.

ape.fixture_note: Only private seed metadata is adapted; current-build save/load must be tested independently. No runtime compatibility bypass.

tomba.fixture_note: Private header adaptation only: codegen and execution cookie. Legacy implementation18xor54474802 unchanged. Current-build save/load must pass independently.

reproduction.method: GetProcessTimes, QueryProcessCycleTime, GetSystemTimes and ReadProcessMemory of production progress/draw/phase/scale counters, every100ms; 120frame warmup then900guestframes. ABBA process restarts with same machine payload; full presenter hidden, paced, debugOFF, dummy audio. Raw source receipts/configs/seeds retained privately.
reproduction.fixture_note: Private seed headers adapted only to current codegen/execution identity. Machine payload is byte-identical within each game; hashes above. Own-build save/load checked independently. No fixture or ROM included.
reproduction.workload: Ape Escape SCUS-94423 first-level phase3 idle checkpoint, 9x/PGXP on; Tomba SCUS-94236 retained gameplay checkpoint, 5x/PGXP off variant. Same features within each pair; existing waits/geometry on both. Samples record actual scale, phase, draws and clock progress.

limitations: Ape only one comparable block; repeatability open.
Short paced checkpoint CPU measurements, not uncappedFPS, GPU timings or all-scene results.
Compiler processes present in some comparable blocks; actual load policy applies. Not an idle-host claim.
No default promotion; pending native card/completion, speaker review, Tomba live/restore explanation and appropriate netplay profile qualification.

raw_counters.format: One JSON object per ABBA run, containing original sampled counters; unrelated process IDs omitted.
